name: Sword of Storms
body:
Sword of Storms

School transmutation [air]; Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 2, hunter 2, magus 3, paladin 3, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (a butterfly’s wing)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target bludgeoning or slashing melee weapon touched
Duration 1 minute/level (see text)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

You infuse the target weapon with a hint of elemental storms, turning the wind of its passing into a whirling gust. Once per round when you miss with an attack using the target weapon, it generates a blast of wind to bull rush the creature, using your caster level as its base attack bonus.

As a full-round action, you can spin the weapon in an arc around you, allowing you to use this bull rush against each creature you threaten with the weapon. In this case, each attack is rolled separately. Using the weapon in this way expends a full minute of the spell’s duration.

Effects that increase your threatened area but not the reach of your weapon (such as Combat Patrol) do not apply.

For the spell’s duration, any time you make a full attack, all physical ranged attacks made against you before the beginning of your next turn suffer penalties as though the wind were two steps stronger.
